export.desc: Saves your log, plans, sites, equipment and settings as one file.
export.privacy: The log contains your observing site coordinates (e.g. your home).
export.roundCoordsHint: Rounds to two decimal places. Turn it on before sharing.
export.includeBlobsHint: Turn it off for a much smaller file.
export.csvHint: The CSV holds observations only (for spreadsheets).
export.iosHint: On iPhone the share sheet opens — choose ‘Save to Files’.

import.desc: Pick a skylog backup (JSON) you exported earlier to restore it.
import.counts: Log {{observations}} · plans {{bookmarks}} · sites {{sites}} · equipment {{equipment}} · sketches & photos {{blobs}}
import.conflicts: {{n}} already here ({{newer}} newer in the file)
import.policyNewestHint: For the same item, only the most recently edited copy is kept.
import.policyAddAllHint: Overlapping items are added as new ones too — the same entry may appear twice.
import.failed: Import did not finish — nothing was changed

error.version: Made by a newer app — please update the app

storage.persistHint: Asks the browser not to evict the log when it frees up space.
storage.persistDenied: The browser hasn't allowed it yet — adding to the home screen helps.
storage.generalNote: Clearing browser data also clears the log. Regular backups are recommended.
storage.iosNote: Safari may delete data after 7 days without use — adding to the home screen makes that less likely. Regular backups are recommended.

danger.confirmHint: Log, plans, sites, equipment and settings will all be deleted and cannot be recovered. Tap again within 5 seconds to delete.

banner.title: It's been over 30 days since your last backup
banner.hint: Saving the log to a file keeps it safe when you change phones.
